scores.tell: Soft, evenly lit white pillow-slab body with toy wheels on a dull grey crater ground. It looks like airbrushed CG and is darker and more scene-like than the real cards.
Barely any. The pommel is slightly bulbous and the leather a touch glossy. It is almost the same as the grade-5 saddle.
The navy body is a slightly heavy dark mass with evenly lacquered plastic. The outer corners are a little soft.
The body corners are a bit puffy, the white keys are chunky, and the gloss is an even candy-plastic sheen, with a slightly sharp pi pattern.
The canopy gores are puffed into glossy pillows that read as candy plastic, not cloth, which leans toward the too-round lesson.
The flowers are inflated balloon shapes and the border stones are soft clay. The hero is small, with a lot of empty pink floor, so it reads too toy and too round.
A busy underwater scene with bubbles, sand, a shell and loose coins. Specular hot spots on the gold and dark contour lines on the bands give it an image-model look.
The squircle body is slightly too toy-like, inflated and evenly lacquered, but the framing and the ring background match the real cards.
Painterly, swooping wood grain with dark grain lines and hand-painted grass blades. It is an illustrated, texture-y style rather than smooth 3D, set in a busy meadow.
The envelope flaps are slightly inflated, and the inner photo carries its own scene detail (a boat and houses), which adds competing focal points.
